turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My mum's birthday is next week and I want to plan something, but money's tight.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: First let me tell you about all of them, then you can comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I could cook her a three course dinner at home and do it all properly with candles.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a picnic by the lake where she used to take us when we were little.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We could also just go to the cinema and get her favourite fish and chips after.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My brother suggested a scrapbook of family photos instead of any outing.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Alright, I'm finished. What's your opinion?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: I'd pair two of them. Do the picnic at the lake, and give her the scrapbook while you're there. The cinema and chips is fun, but it's a bit like any other evening out.
